description.en:
itemBhv
Indicates whether the item ID from the real-time behavior record exists in the item database.
userBhv
Indicates whether the user ID from the real-time behavior record exists in the user database.
bhvTypeBhv
Indicates whether the bhv\_type value from the real-time behavior record is valid.
traceIdBhv
Indicates whether the trace\_id value from the real-time behavior record is valid.
traceInfoBhv
Indicates whether the trace\_info value from the real-time behavior record is valid.
itemItem
Indicates whether the item ID in the update record is valid.
userUser
Indicates whether the user ID in the update record is valid.
